dataset: Marshall Fire 2021 published quantitative calibration targets
interpretation: Only numbers printed in the cited source are recorded. No value is derived, interpolated or estimated. Survey statistics describe a convenience sample and are not population rates.

forrister-2024-tbs.citation: Forrister A, Kuligowski ED, Sun Y, Yan X, Lovreglio R, Cova TJ, Zhao X. Analyzing Risk Perception, Evacuation Decision and Delay Time: A Case Study of the 2021 Marshall Fire in Colorado. Travel Behaviour and Society 35 (2024) 100729.

coloradosun-2022-01-26.citation: Najmabadi S, Prentzel O. Marshall fire evacuation alerts reached as few as 1 in 5 who were meant to receive them. The Colorado Sun, 2022-01-26.

targets.metric: Everbridge notifications launched (sum of total contacts over 9 messages)
targets.location: Boulder County Everbridge launch areas Marshall Fire 1-9
targets.source_locator: p. 3, table 'What messages were sent during the Marshall Fire?' (Total Contacts column; the nine rows sum to this value)
targets.note: Contacts are registered contact paths (landline, VoIP, opted-in cell, text, email), not people or households.

targets.metric: Everbridge notifications confirmed received during the emergency
targets.source_locator: paragraph 3 (cites new Boulder County Sheriff's Office data)
targets.note: Unconfirmed does not mean not received; confirmation required e.g. pressing 1.

targets.metric: Share of the 24,289 notifications that went unconfirmed

targets.location: Superior, Louisville and unincorporated Boulder County

targets.metric: Law enforcement resources performing door-to-door evacuations
targets.location: Superior, Louisville and unincorporated Boulder County

targets.note: Convenience sample (social media + Qualtrics panel); 294 valid responses before exclusion.

Share of respondents receiving a pre-evacuation notice, warning or order from an official source

targets.metric: Share of respondents alerted or warned to evacuate by someone they knew
Mean awareness time (minutes after midnight, 2021-12-30 local)
